entry.title: [UPDATED] MAL-2026-17787: Malicious code in evm-tx-decoder (RubyGems)
entry.content:
Malicious code in evm-tx-decoder (RubyGems)

Affected:

  • evm-tx-decoder

--- _-= Per source details. Do not edit below this line.=-_ ## Source: amazon-inspector (e478aa0270779720106fc6169e89fde089af352214fc720fbf8c284d51415f59) The gem's native-extension build script ext/extconf.rb decodes a base64-embedded Ruby payload and executes it via eval inside a double-forked, detached child (Process.setsid, Process.detach). The payload opens a TCPSocket to the hardcoded bare-IP C2 at 45.138.12.177:8089 and connects it bidirectionally to /bin/sh via IO.popen and IO.copy_stream, yielding an interactive remote shell on the installer host at `gem install` time. Execution is gated by anti-analysis checks that suppress the payload in CI, on ephemeral/sandbox hostnames, with generated analyst usernames, in common analysis path prefixes, when uptime is below 1800 seconds, or…

References:

  • https://rubygems.org/gems/evm-tx-decoder/versions/0.9.1
